inspiration: Hit reaction as a timed state with a branch: stand-hit shake holds until a timer ends, then goes to knockback or fall by the hit's air or ground flags (data/common1.cns.zss line 497 onward, line 499 shake choice). Keep the timed shake; change the axis and the ending.

Just-defend window: a short perfect-guard window opened from the first guard frame while holding back; a guard hit inside it sets a flag (data/functions.zss line 68 IkSys_JustDefend; window written as gameTime plus 3 at line 73). Keep the window; change the reward.
Edge-triggered low-life cue: one-shot flag when life first drops to a quarter of max (data/functions.zss line 85 IkSys_Danger, condition at line 87). Keep the one-shot; change the look and sound.

Deterministic order of operations in collision: characters sorted by priority (reversal, then hit definition, then none; ties by id), push pass, then gethit flag reset, then hit detection (src/char.go lines 14904-14957). Keep the order; use our server tick and ids.
Parry as a reversal flag latched once per game time (data/functions.zss line 56 IkSys_Parry). Keep the once-per-tick latch; change the timing ring.
Input buffer through hit pause via command entries (data/common.cmd line 11, buffer.hitpause). Keep a buffer that runs through hitstop; relevant to the hud-ui input-buffer fold-in.
Common states and common commands as data appended to every character (data/common1.cns.zss; data/common.cmd header; data/common.air header). Data-first, the same shape as our catalogue fields.

briefs.label: stand-hit shake (own label, effect)
briefs.why: a hit reaction that holds for a timer and then branches
briefs.keep: shake until a timer ends, then knock or fall by air or ground
briefs.change: shake along a different axis; a short grey flash at the end

briefs.label: just-defend window (own label, mechanic)
briefs.why: a short perfect-guard window readable at 375 wide
briefs.keep: a three-tick window from the first guard frame
briefs.change: shield-ring visual and a stamina refund rather than a bonus flag

briefs.label: low-life pulse (own label, effect)
briefs.why: one cue the first time life drops to a quarter
briefs.keep: one-shot edge trigger at a quarter of max life
briefs.change: heartbeat sound instead of a red vignette

briefs.label: reversal ordering (own label, mechanic)
briefs.why: a reversal on the same tick as a hit wins by priority, deterministically
briefs.keep: reversal first, then hit definition, then none; ties by id
briefs.change: our server tick and entity ids; a timing ring on the enemy's feet

briefs.label: dizzy stars (own label, effect)
briefs.why: a status that is high only while active and emits one event per tick
briefs.keep: one event per tick while the status holds
briefs.change: stars orbit the head, not a sprite
